info.what: Watches the metrics and notifies a person when something crosses a limit.
info.why: Problems are noticed and fixed quickly, at any hour, instead of being discovered by customers.

samples.caption: A rule: page someone if errors stay high for 5 minutes
samples.code:
alert: HighErrorRate
expr: error_rate > 0.05
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: Over 5% of requests fail
